title: Novel Janus XGa–PbP (X = S, Se) monolayers: excellent photocatalysts for overall water splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31076-31087
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04300J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Khawla Chaoui, Warda Elaggoune, Luc Henrard, Kamel Zanat, Mohamed Achehboune
Janus V–IV–III–VI monolayers ( SGa–PbP, SeGa–PbP) show structural stability, tunable optoelectronics, and excellent photocatalytic activity, making them strong candidates for solar-driven hydrogen production.
